h1: Dune Allen "Santa Rosa One" 5055 West County Hwy 30A Unit 1029
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Spectacular Gulf views- 50 feet from private beach - across private street- Community pool- Near excellent restaurants, including Shunk Gulley- 6-passenger golf cart- 5 adult bikes- Parking for 2 vehicles - 1 in the garage and 1 in the driveway- Gas fireplace - Gas grill- Professionally decorated - Private elevator- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Mediterranean style meets stunning Gulf views! Every now and then, you come across a home that takes your breath away, and so it is with "Santa Rosa One," a 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom, professionally-decorated 30A getaway just 50 feet from the beach. Take in a day at the sugar-soft sand and then relax on one of the two sprawling balconies overlooking the Gulf. In the evening, head down to Shunk Gulley for oysters. This 3-story coastal retreat also features a community pool, a gas fireplace, and a private elevator.The heart of this home is on the third floor, where you'll find a chef's kitchen featuring designer cabinets, select stainless appliances, a gas range, and granite countertops. The kitchen opens onto the dining area with table seating for 6 guests, while the counter offers seating for an additional 6 guests. Timber beam ceilings and hardwood floors highlight the open floor plan. The living room offers a flat-screen television, gas fireplace, and a sleeper sofa offering quarters for 2 guests. The living room also has access to a sprawling deck with staggering Gulf views and table seating for 6 guests.The first floor has 2 bunk rooms - one with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds and a private bathroom with a shower and the other with a full-over-full bunk bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. Heading upstairs, the second floor has 3 bedrooms. The Primary suite has a king bed, private bathroom with a beautiful shower and tub, and a private balcony with stunning Gulf views. Adjacent are 2 guest bedrooms - one with a king bed and a shared bathroom with a shower and the other has 2 queen beds and a shared bathroom with a shower. "Santa Rosa One" can sleep up to 18 guests.This gorgeous 30A getaway is situated in the heart of Dune Allen Beach, just steps from great restaurants and an amazing variety of artisan shops. All of the communities of 30A are just down the road, with Grayton, Blue Mountain Beach, WaterColor and Seaside only a few miles away. Low-Speed Vehicle included! Book this coastal gem today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:- Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower - Bunk Room: Full-over-Full Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower - Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Balcony, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubTHIRD FLOOR:- Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.**No tents/canopies allowed on the private beach access**
